interpretation: The eight consensus classes all have zero foreign-field references under this registered references-only rule. This cannot establish that the source methods never access foreign state.

CloudStack has 1,042 reads and 6,161 writes edges outside the registered field-reference rule. Eclipse was extracted by an older producer and has no such relations. They must be studied separately before combining categories.
Method-to-own-field references and method-call links are available in many classes, but coverage and source truth are unverified. Missing edges cannot be interpreted as low cohesion.
These are known Java development graphs. No WMC, ATFD, TCC or god-object score, Graphify rerun, independent holdout, or cross-language conclusion is present.
limits: A graph relation is stored producer evidence, not independent source verification.

Only direct class-to-method/field contains edges and method calls/references were inventoried. CloudStack also has reads/writes relations; treating them as equivalent requires a separate declared analysis.
Missing field references do not establish low cohesion. WMC, ATFD, TCC and god-object scores were not computed.
These are two known Java development graphs from different Compass producer versions; no Graphify rerun or new holdout was used.

method.calls: Directed method calls method edges, split by uniquely owned internal, foreign, and unresolved method targets.
method.field: Directed method references field edges, split by uniquely owned own, foreign, and unresolved field targets.
method.ownership: Only direct directed class contains method/field edges; a member must have exactly one distinct class owner.
method.provenance: Stored relation confidence and exact source-anchor counts are retained separately; neither validates the source target independently.
method.sampleJoin: The previously registered exact file/name/span identity join, with no fallback for unavailable cases.

purpose: Inventory graph-stored class/member relationships before designing a responsibility or cohesion measure; no defect classifier or new competitor score.
rawPerClassRecord: All 13,001 class IDs and their relationship counts remain in the hash-bound external raw run; this public review includes aggregate graph counts and all 55 reviewed class records.
